title: Production acceptance blocked: supplied visible Chrome CDP session is unavailable

evidence: Initial CDP attach failed with EPERM in the sandbox.
Approved retry to the same endpoint failed with ECONNREFUSED.
The Google Chrome application was activated in the foreground.
Listener inspection found no Chrome/Chromium TCP debugging listener.
The visible Google Chrome main process (PID 81303) has no --remote-debugging-port argument.
blocker.impact: No observable browser page can be inspected; therefore target availability, exact runtime revision, screenshots, visual geometry, overlay interactions, and live Plotly gestures cannot be evidenced.

p0_failures.user_visible_symptom: No live Plotly graph is visible in production.
p0_failures.runtime_root_cause: The deployed frontend's `public/js/layouts.js` accepts only the state-lite envelope: `normalizeEnvelope()` requires `state_revision`, `calculation_revision`, `layouts`, exactly one active output, and active-output metadata. Production `GET /api/state` returned HTTP 200 with the legacy `plots` payload, but without `layouts` or `calculation_revision`. The envelope is rejected, so `acceptEnvelope()` does not populate `layoutsByDisplay`/`outputsByDisplay`; no ready pane host reaches `queuePaneRender()` or `Plotly.react()`.

affected_files: public/js/layouts.js: normalizeEnvelope(), acceptEnvelope(), refresh(), renderPanePlots(), queuePaneRender()
app/lib production state-envelope provider for GET /api/state and GET /api/outputs/active

p0_failures.owner: Orchestrator -> DevOps for exact revision/runtime correlation; then Backender and Frontend for the state-envelope contract.

p0_failures.user_visible_symptom: Production contains incomplete styling and mixed legacy zones.

legacy_shell_surfaces: public/index.html: pre-v2 active-pane runtime markup (`active-pane-runtime`, `active-plot-host`) remains in the document shell
public/index.html: legacy native `<select>` settings markup and legacy bottom-zone/table shell
public/css/layouts.css: original legacy rules remain before the appended DESIGN v2 overrides, creating cascade-dependent mixed zones
design_contract_zones_affected: plot workspace / pane header and canvas
popup/overlay entry surfaces dependent on the legacy shell

p0_failures.owner: Frontend after DevOps confirms the runtime revision; the current visible result must not be accepted as design v2.
